function_protocol.dpi_ou_gmm_d100: 960 held-out points from the official sampling law
function_protocol.allen_cahn_d100: 410 held-out forward-law points; diagnostic because Deep BSDE is native single-point

actor_selection: held-out noisy tangent-label loss plus a fixed reference-free policy-value bank; headline selection is restricted to MCV-training candidates and plain-FK training is an ablation

actor_search.successive_halving: one update for all; continue the best two reference-free candidates

conditional_upper_budget.launch_rule: launch one update only if the staged runs stay finite and either continue to lower replicated policy value or leave held-out Actor error above five times independent label-replication RMSE; require projected wall time below the two-hour allocation limit
conditional_upper_budget.continuation_rule: continue beyond one update only if the replicated common-bank ranking improves over the staged winner without Ground Truth

mcv.inference: plain and corrected estimates share paths

baseline_policy: official architecture and algorithm; no Tangent-Actor terminal feature or MCV added

full_history_control.configuration_selection: fixed before results; all completed configurations are reported

cost_accounting: synchronized wall time; training and total time both reported
